name: FLOOWBOX - TikTok Trend Monitor and Script Writer

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - TikTok Trend Monitor
Runs every morning at 7 AM.
Perplexity searches for trending TikTok formats + sounds this week.
GPT-4o writes 3 ready-to-record scripts using the trends.
Scripts saved to Notion + briefing posted to Slack.

Change niche config in Set Niche Config node.
